name: Ponca City MX
address: West Prospect Ave area near Ponca City Regional Airport, Ponca City, OK (street number not confirmed)

layout.notes: City-owned land developed into a nationally known amateur venue.

conditions.wet: Prone to flooding: a 2013 storm submerged the track and cancelled a day; severe flooding moved the 2025 South Central Area Qualifier to Sweet 16 MX (Muskogee).
conditions.seasonal: Long-time home of the NMA Grand National (moved to Norman, OK in 2012); since then hosts Loretta Lynn regional/area qualifiers and a fall MotoPlayground race.

rider_reports.says: Race report: overnight storm left the track under water and wind damage; Wednesday motos were cancelled and run Thursday.
